issues.description: Duplicate React hook imports in step-3/page.tsx causing a build error (500). Both 'useState, useEffect' and 'useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState' are imported from 'react' on separate lines, causing 'useEffect is defined multiple times' and 'useState is defined multiple times' compile errors.
issues.root_cause: There are two separate import lines from 'react' at the top of step-3/page.tsx: line 2 has `import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';` and line 4 has `import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';`. The first line is a stale/duplicate import that must be removed.

issues.description: Hydration mismatch: server renders 'Which room are we designing?' (step-1 content) but client tries to render step-3 content, causing full client re-render. The page title shown is wrong for the current route /design/step-3.
issues.element: Page title / header text mismatch between server and client
issues.root_cause: The duplicate import causes a build failure/500 on step-3, so Next.js falls back to serving cached or wrong page HTML. Fixing the duplicate import should resolve the 500 and hydration error.

issues.description: Current screen is showing /design/step-2 UI (room selection) instead of the expected step-3b style blend confirmation with percentage bars. The flow is stuck or navigating to the wrong step.
issues.element: Wrong page content displayed for step-3b
issues.root_cause: Because step-3/page.tsx fails to compile (500 error from duplicate imports), the router cannot navigate forward, leaving the user on step-2. Once the duplicate import is fixed, the flow should proceed.

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
fixes.reason: Removes the duplicate/stale first import line that causes the 'useEffect is defined multiple times' and 'useState is defined multiple times' build errors, which are causing the 500 and preventing step-3 from rendering.
